This is a placeholder. To add an essay, copy this file into the `writing` folder, give it a new name (for example `on-free-will.qmd`), change the title, description, date and categories at the top, and write the essay below the second `---` line.

Use **bold** for the words you want to stand out, the way the home page does. Categories can be anything; `philosophy`, `literature` and `singularity` would match the home page.

> A block quote looks like this, for passages you want to set apart.
